🇺🇸 Thousands march through Times Square under “No Schumer, No Jeffries” signs after Democrats win the House and Senate

It's called "March for Our Democracy", and it celebrates the midterm results while pressuring the party’s incoming leadership.

Progressive groups are calling for contested votes instead of automatically returning Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries to their posts.

The split within the Democratic Party is now openly visible, even before the new Congress takes office.
